objective: Audit the proposed external-validation architecture with priority on causal hypothesis backtesting, universe construction, configuration/variant completeness, anti-lookahead, multiplicity, cross-genealogy dedupe and independent parity; persist corrections without altering frozen V255 science.

findings.finding: The prior proposal placed Qlib/LEAN/Nautilus too early as the main improvement. Execution-engine independence cannot repair an incomplete, semantically drifting or retrospectively expanded causal universe.
findings.correction: External engines are constrained to signal-oracle, execution-oracle or separately preregistered sandbox roles. They may not generate or select candidates in validation mode.

findings.finding: Two independent enumerators prove equality of the configuration set, not equality of causal feature/event interpretation.
findings.correction: Add mandatory INDEPENDENT_SIGNAL_ORACLE_PARITY between config freeze and development backtest.

findings.finding: The inspected machine-universe and fixed-point artifacts enumerate MTF/timeframe dimensions but do not themselves bind bar origin, partial-bar policy and per-feature closed-bar availability. The audit does not claim such bindings are absent elsewhere.
findings.correction: Require explicit bar-clock and per-feature observability bindings before universe closure. CLOSED_BAR features require closed_bar_offset>=1.

findings.finding: Existing receipt correctly limits fixed point to the frozen genealogy radius. Risk remains that downstream users interpret fixed point as universal strategy-space exhaustion.
findings.correction: Policy makes this limitation a hard wording invariant and requires an ex-ante interaction-depth rationale.

findings.finding: A hard max_active_filter_families=2 is computationally useful but is not, by itself, a causal proof that depth-3+ interactions are unnecessary.
findings.correction: Every future campaign must preregister interaction depth and causal rationale. Depth is expanded only for causal mechanism coverage, never because PnL suggests more search.

findings.finding: Plateau/sensitivity analysis can become retrospective if neighboring parameter points are added only after a profitable cell appears.
findings.correction: Parameter neighborhoods and boundary points must be frozen before economic results.

findings.finding: Within-shard exact event-mask aliases are controlled, but the inspected contracts do not by themselves establish a project-wide pre-PnL collision gate against prior genealogies.
findings.correction: Require mechanism fingerprint plus exact event-mask collision audit against prior genealogies before economic scoring. Near duplicates are annotated only and cannot reduce N_TESTS.

findings.finding: The frozen per-shard BY allocation is explicit and conservative, but the campaign-level operating characteristics under actual cross-shard dependence are not demonstrated by the inspected contract alone.
findings.correction: Keep existing frozen current policy unchanged; require prospective campaign-level null calibration/permutation diagnostic in addition to the formal multiplicity contract.

findings.finding: Trade-by-trade parity can still allow shared semantic errors if both implementations copy the same assumption.
findings.correction: Add metamorphic invariants for future truncation, cost/slippage monotonicity, bar resample causality, timestamp order, Bid/Ask sides and naive-vs-optimized parity.

findings.finding: Applying these corrections directly to frozen V255 would invalidate config identities and preregistration.
findings.correction: Policy is prospective-only. V255 receives no universe, parameter, multiplicity or economic change.

scientific_effect.prospective_effect: Adds a pre-PnL causal-universe hardening gate for new campaigns/descendants after explicit adoption.

next_automatic_action: Persist policy, validator, fixture, tests and this audit on an isolated branch; read back exact bytes; open a review PR. Do not merge or alter V255 scientific authority automatically.
